newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican auto production, exports up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Mexican auto production, exports up sharply.

text.p: Mexican auto production for the first eight months of this year was 823,112 units, up 38.7 percent from the same period in 1995, when 593,628 vehicles were produced, the Mexican Association of the Automobile Industry said in a news release.
The association also reported that exports in the January-to-August period totalled 663,452 units, up 38.4 percent from the same period in 1995, when 479,280 units were sold abroad.
